sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Header explaining the three modes
sections.what: Explains the three modes and states that every artifact is set to warn, on purpose.
sections.why: The header explains that blocking now would stop almost every numeral because almost none are linked to source spans.
sections.watch_out: Turning on block is a product decision, and the header asks the owner to read the measurement first.

sections.name: E25_ARTIFACT_IDS, E25ArtifactId
sections.title: Names of the three artifacts
sections.what: Gives a fixed name to each of the three artifacts the gate checks.
sections.why: Using names avoids typing the ID strings by hand in several places.
sections.watch_out: A new artifact needs its own entry here, or it falls back to warn without notice.

sections.name: MODES
sections.title: Mode settings for each artifact
sections.why: The header says all artifacts stay on warn for now.
sections.watch_out: Changing one value here changes how strictly that artifact is checked right away.

sections.name: resolveMode
sections.title: Looking up an artifact's mode
sections.what: Returns the mode for an artifact ID, and returns warn when the ID is not listed.
sections.why: The comment says unknown artifacts should never be blocked and never be silenced.
sections.watch_out: A typo in an artifact ID gives warn silently, so a missing check is not visible.

summary: Sets the enforcement level of the numeric provenance check for each of the three generated artifacts, and all three are currently set to warn.
purpose: Keeps the enforcement level for each artifact in one place, so it can be changed without editing the checker.
why: Likely reason: the header says all artifacts stay on warn because blocking now would stop almost every number from rendering, since few numbers are linked to source spans.
how: Lists the three artifact IDs, assigns each one a mode of off, warn, or block, and returns the mode for a requested artifact. Any unknown ID returns warn.
inputs: An artifact ID string, such as the one for the lessons learnt deck.
outputs: A mode: off, warn, or block.
risks: Setting an artifact to block would refuse rendering below the threshold. Setting it to off stops the check with no visible error.
debug: If a numeral is not being checked, confirm the artifact ID matches one of the three listed IDs. A typo quietly gives warn, not an error.
